title: CRISPR observability: interactive scientific map
subtitle: Premises, mechanisms, conditional constraints, source artifacts, revision tests and scope
map_semantics: Typed navigation of frozen evidence and declared conditional support. AND gates preserve joint premises; ordinary source and revision-condition edges are not causal effects. Node positions, counts and filters do not quantify evidential strength.

source_scope.description: Offline numerical and epistemic companion built from frozen source data; manuscript and supplement text are withheld from this public artifact.
source_scope.interpretation: Conditional finite-record identification hulls under correct accepted labels; no sampling confidence coverage is claimed.

calculation_contract.partition: E + NE + U = N; all are nonnegative integers and N > 0.
calculation_contract.completion: (E+k)/N for integer k from0 throughU is an attainable hypothetical completion, not an observed estimate. If a slider uses q in[0,1], set k=round(q*U) and displayk.
calculation_contract.counterfactualWarning: Changing q or counts does not add reads or biological evidence. Published records remain immutable.
assumptions: Accepted labels are correct for the declared event.
Every unknown may independently be event or non-event.
Two-arm worst-case completion is independent between declared raw universes.

paper_refs.fails: Local obstructions and recorded disagreement; no universal observer ranking.
paper_refs.candidate: Declared future checks; no new biological experiment is asserted.
paper_refs.open: Correction conditions and future evidence requirements.
paper_refs.blocked: Molecular truth calibration and prospective transport remain outside this released evidence.
paper_refs.supported: Frozen observations, numerical artifacts and verified source identities.
paper_refs.all: Current public numerical companion. The full manuscript and formal supplement remain private.
